Messages.Body:
Do you think some type of card with the following effect would be playable or just wallpaper?:

Minion cards played by X are removed from the game instead of going to the ash heap when burned.

Where X could be just prey or just prey+pred or even all Meth.

Could this be an   a master a vampire's unique ability a dsicpline related ability.

Discuss

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Seems like an anti-"vampire recursion" tech. Trouble is that "vampire recursion" decks are already hard to put with, and not overwhelmingly strong.
That kind of card is not really needed (plus you can play The Name Forgotten if you really need to).

( 1.6. Overview of Library Cards
1.6.1. General
Playing Cards. There are four main types of library cards: convictions, master cards, minion cards and event cards. Convictions are put in play during the untap phase (see details in the Imbued Rules appendix); master cards are played by Methuselahs; minion cards are played by the minions (vampires and allies) the Methuselahs control; event cards are put into play during the discard phase to represent events that affects the World of Darkness as a whole (see section 8). )
